summary: Frontend-only Phase G verification (IST timezone, FCM push, live polling, per-channel notification indicators). Firebase SW served correctly, IST label rendered in admin 'Last updated' after scheduling, scheduler pre-fill values persist across expand/collapse and match the saved payload, FCM silently degrades (no /api/notifications/fcm-token XHR because NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* env vars are placeholders), and 30s polling loop fires the initial silent GET /api/account/bookings/:id on detail-page mount. NotificationChannels correctly renders NOTHING when backend does not return emailSent/smsSent/pushSent — anti-fake AC #6 verified. Same customer-side hydration race noted in iteration_1 still blocks a fully rendered customer detail page in Playwright (hard-nav redirects to /login before Zustand persist re-hydrates), so consultation-date / consultation-time / tz-label / customer-note testids were only exercised via the code path (initial silent GET fires) rather than a fully rendered DOM. Every DOM-observable claim in the AC list that does not require the customer detail page to stay mounted is verified end-to-end.

integration_issues.flow: Customer /account/bookings/[bookingId] auth-guard hydration race (recurring from iteration_1)
integration_issues.issue: app/account/layout.tsx line 42-44: `useEffect(() => { if (!user) router.push('/login') }, [user, router])` fires on first render before Zustand persist rehydrates from localStorage on hard navigation, so Playwright cannot reach the detail page even after a valid login and same-tab client-side transition. Gate the redirect on a `hasHydrated` flag from `persist(onRehydrateStorage)` OR use `useAuthStore.persist.hasHydrated()` before pushing. Same recommendation as iteration_1.

Render backend https://vastu-arya-backend-1.onrender.com/api still does not allow Origin https://d317c2b3-166c-4af0-9b7d-90eecbbf92b6.preview.emergentagent.com — every real XHR is blocked and OPTIONS returns 500 {message: 'Not allowed by CORS'}. Testing had to fall back to Playwright route interception; recommend backend team whitelist the preview host.

action_items: Gate the /account/* auth guard on Zustand persist's hasHydrated() flag so the customer booking detail page can survive a hard navigation. Same fix applies to /admin/* layout. Recommended: `const hydrated = useAuthStore.persist.hasHydrated(); useEffect(() => { if (hydrated && !user) router.push('/login'); }, [hydrated, user]);` and return null while !hydrated.
Request backend team to whitelist the preview host in the Render backend CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin so real E2E tests can hit production data instead of Playwright route interception.
Consider adding a `data-testid=notification-channels-container` wrapper that is always rendered (even empty) so tests can distinguish 'component mounted but no channels' from 'component not reached'.
critical_code_review_comments: app/account/layout.tsx uses `useFcmToken()` at module top-level — good. But the hook silently returns when `!firebaseConfigured()` — this is the right behaviour; verified no side effects when env is missing.

app/account/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx line 128-132: the visibilitychange listener is added but its cleanup (removeEventListener) is NOT returned from useEffect. Only `stop()` (which clears the interval) is returned. Repeated re-renders of bookingId would stack listeners across a session. Minor leak, low priority.

lib/datetime.ts formatInstantIST returns '' for invalid input (line 128) — good defensive default. The IST suffix and `en-IN` locale produce 'DD Mon YYYY, H:MM am/pm IST' which is exactly what the AC asks for. Verified.
public/firebase-messaging-sw.js — reads config from query string, silently no-ops if apiKey/projectId/appId missing (line 39). Correctly satisfies 'never crash the SW' contract.

hooks/useFcmToken.ts — good defensive pattern (silent-degrade at every branch, ref-guard against double-run). Only tiny nit: on repeated re-renders of the layout across route changes, the effect only runs once thanks to the empty dep array + started.current, but the `onForegroundMessage` closure captures the FIRST caller's callback. Not a bug for the current usage (no onForegroundMessage passed), just note for future.
app/admin/bookings/page.tsx — still uses `require('react') as any` at line 45 (unchanged from iteration_1). Cosmetic only.
app/admin/bookings/page.tsx grew to ~372 lines — still under the 700-line threshold, but the ScheduleConsultationCard sub-tree is a natural extraction target.

success_rate.frontend: Admin flow: 100% (IST label, prefill, scheduler workflow). Firebase SW / silent-degrade: 100%. Polling loop initial-mount: 100%. Notification channels anti-fake: 100%. Customer full render: BLOCKED by hydration race — verified via code review + poll_count observation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) The running next-server MUST be restarted after any `yarn build`: `pkill -f next-server; cd /app && PORT=3000 HOST=0.0.0.0 nohup yarn start > /tmp/nextjs.log 2>&1 &` — otherwise the served HTML still points to a stale chunk hash and admin routes blank out with ChunkLoadError. 2) Production Render backend CORS blocks the preview origin — Playwright route interception is required for real API E2E. 3) Customer /account/* auth-guard hydration race means Playwright cannot reach /account/bookings/:id even with valid login + client-side transition — either fix the guard (see action_items[0]) or use `useAuthStore.persist.hasHydrated()` pattern. 4) The mocked login endpoint MUST return `{success, user, token}` at top level (not `{success, data:{user, token}}`) because app/admin/login/page.tsx line 22 uses `const { data } = await authAPI.login(...)` and then `data.user.role` directly. 5) Firebase env vars are intentionally blank — verified silent-degrade works.
rca_of_the_issue: Two verified behaviours + one persistent environmental blocker: (a) formatInstantIST correctly renders 'DD Mon YYYY, H:MM am/pm IST' — no bug. (b) NotificationChannels correctly hides when backend returns no channel flags — no bug. Persistent blocker: same customer-side hydration race as iteration_1 — /account/layout.tsx redirects to /login before persist rehydrates on hard navigation. Recommended mitigation is a hasHydrated() flag in the guard. All Phase G Acceptance Criteria that can be verified from the admin side + code paths PASS; the two customer-side DOM assertions (consultation-* testids + notification-channels pills after refresh) are gated on the guard fix.
